Values._comment_runtime_storage: Connection string with AccountKey, used by the Functions runtime (BlobTrigger control queue, QueueTrigger listener, host singleton lease). RBAC bypassed for runtime state so we don't depend on per-user role propagation. Copy this file to local.settings.json and fill in real values — local.settings.json is gitignored.
Values._comment_app_storage: Blob endpoint URI for app-level clients (BlobServiceClient + QueueServiceClient registered in Program.cs). These remain identity-based via DefaultAzureCredential. Queue URI is derived by swapping .blob. → .queue.
